messages:
devon: Heads up — PR #3248 needs a quick review before the 18:00 UTC cut. Small fix for smoke flakiness in the tokenizer that broke some local infra tests. All unit/integration passed; smoke failed in staging. Can someone take a look & approve? backport to `release-1.3` required. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood-inference/pulls/3248 :pray:

olivia: grabbing it now, will skim the diff.

kevin: pinging @olivia and @maya — I can review too if you get busy. quick glance: change looks safe but want to run staging quick smoke after merge.

release-bot: Reminder: cut window for release-1.3 closes at 18:00 UTC. Backports must be merged to `release-1.3` before the cut to be included.

maya: quick question — do we need a separate changelog entry for this? it's a bugfix that affects test infra only.

devon: thanks — I added a one-line changelog snippet in the PR description under "changelog:". It's small but org policy asks for any behavior-fix note. snippet: ```changelog: Fix flakiness in tokenizer smoke tests that caused intermittent CI failures.```

olivia: reviewed. left one tiny nit (naming in a test helper). not blocking but please address so the backport is clean. :pencil:

devon: fixed the helper name and pushed; CI retriggered. thanks.

kevin: ran staging smoke locally against the patch, looks good. approving now. :white_check_mark:

olivia: approved too.

release-bot: Merge queue trigger: PR #3248 queued for merge into `main` and backport to `release-1.3`. Expect merges in ~5m.

devon: awesome — will watch the backport merge. if anything goes wrong ping me here and I'll roll back. thanks all! :rocket:
